# NOVA

NOVA is a privacy-first mental wellness platform that helps people track sleep, energy, workload, emotional patterns, and everyday routines with responsible AI guidance.

## Key pages
- https://nova-mentalwellness.com/
- https://nova-mentalwellness.com/en
- https://nova-mentalwellness.com/pt

## Description
NOVA offers daily check-ins, private emotional tracking, and AI-powered insights that help users understand how sleep, workload, and mood connect over time.
